no_applications: No applications are assigned to you. An administrator can assign an owner.
credentials_help: Only the application owner provides these credentials. The Auth Token is encrypted and is never shown again.
rotation_help: Saving a new token pauses this connection. Activate the selected number again after rotation.
activation_help: Select the exact number. Activation changes only its Voice and call-status webhooks; WhatsApp is configured separately.
no_numbers: No phone numbers found in this account.
confirm_replace: I approve replacing the selected number's existing Voice service.
linked_caller: Recognize previously linked callers without a regular PIN (first linking still requires proof).
allow_outbound: Allow outbound calls for verified application accounts.
billing_help: Twilio bills its account holder directly. Aurvek and AI usage retain their configured charges.
disconnect_help: Pausing prevents new calls and retains credentials for closing and reconciling existing calls. Webhooks stay assigned; recovery settings are retained below.
error.twilio_encryption_unavailable: Valid encryption configuration is required. Contact the administrator.
error.twilio_connection_unavailable: This connection is unavailable. Connect or activate it first.
error.twilio_connection_changed: The connection changed. Reload the page before retrying.
error.twilio_number_unavailable: The number is unavailable in this connection.
error.twilio_validation_failed: Twilio could not validate this connection. Check your credentials and retry.
error.twilio_credentials_invalid: Enter a valid Account SID and Auth Token.
error.twilio_number_in_use: This number is already in use. Select another number.
error.twilio_webhook_confirmation_requir: Review the existing Voice service and explicitly approve replacing it.
error.twilio_configuration_unconfirmed: Twilio has not confirmed the change. New calls remain paused; reload and review the saved recovery settings.
dtmf_access_code: Please enter your personal access code, followed by the pound key.
